I replied to Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message: the contact is Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines.

That comes from two places Marcus can see himself. Dana posted in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025 that Thea had flagged the door 6 duplicate arrivals again on the morning shift, and that she was looking into it. The public North team cheat sheet also lists Thea as QFL's main contact. No finance figures or private messages went into the reply.
